# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIV_NAMED_LEVEL

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price reaches a named level (prior day high/low, weekly high/low) and makes a new extreme while RSI fails to confirm the extreme and volume dries up, a reversal is likely. This captures exhaustion at structurally significant levels where momentum diverges from price, offering a high-probability counter‑trend entry.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price is within 0.1% of a named level and makes a new high (for shorts) or new low (for longs) while the 14‑bar RSI does not make a corresponding extreme (bearish divergence for shorts, bullish divergence for longs) and the bar’s volume is <80% of the average volume of the prior five bars, enter opposite direction at the bar’s close. Stop is placed beyond the named level (chart‑stop). Exit: TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed with a premium‑stop (e.g., trail 12% of highest‑since‑entry price). Regime filter: VIX 15‑25 and time 11:00‑13:30 ET.
